verses.1: These are the laws and regulations that you must keep. These are the rules that Yahweh, your God, has given you to inherit from your ancestors. You must obey these laws throughout all the days you live on this earth.
verses.2: May they be destroyed! May all those places where the nations worshipped their gods be destroyed. You will inherit those places, along with all the trees that produce fruit.
verses.3: And you shall destroy their idols and break their altars. Their gods will be burned in fire, and their names will be forgotten from that place.
verses.4: Do not do such things to the LORD your God.
verses.5: For in that place where Jehovah your God chooses from among all your tribes to place His name, there you shall dwell. You have come to that place.
verses.6: And you shall bring your livestock, and your offerings, and all your sacrifices. You shall also bring your fingers, your wrists, your fruits of your labor, and your livestock as offerings.
verses.7: And you shall eat there before your God, and you shall rejoice in all that He has given you. And your children, whom Jehovah your God has blessed, shall also enjoy those things.
verses.8: Do not do everything that we do today. Everyone who does such things is considered righteous in their own eyes.
verses.9: For you have not yet come to the place of rest and to the inheritance that Jehovah your God has given you.
verses.10: And you shall cross the Jordan River. Then you shall settle in the land that Jehovah your God gives to you. He will free you from all your enemies around you, and you shall live in safety.
verses.11: And it shall be the place that Jehovah your God chooses for setting His name there. You shall bring all that I command you to be offered there: your sacrifices, your offerings, the blood of your animals, and all your offerings of grain. And you shall bring all the offerings that you are required to offer to Jehovah.
verses.12: Rejoice before Jehovah your God! You, your children, your daughters, your servants, and your maids, and even the livestock that are in your fields – for they have no share or inheritance with you.
verses.13: Be careful, so that you won’t be defeated wherever you go.
verses.14: For in the place that Jehovah has chosen for one of your rulers, there you shall reign over your people. And there you shall do all that I command you to do.
verses.15: Only in all your hearts will you worship and eat the flesh as a blessing from Jehovah your God, who has given it to you in every door of your house, both the dirty and the clean. We will eat it like birds and locusts.
verses.16: Only blood shall not be eaten on the earth; it must be poured out like water.
verses.17: You shall not eat in your gates the fruits of your own fields, your livestock, and your crops. Nor shall you eat any of your own possessions, your livestock, and all your valuables.
verses.18: For before Jehovah your God, you will eat in the place that Jehovah your God has chosen for you. You, your sons, your daughters, your servants, and your flocks will also eat there. You will rejoice before Jehovah your God in all the work of your hands.
verses.19: Be careful not to leave the livestock on your land all day long.
verses.20: For Jehovah your God will expand your territory, just as you have spoken and said. You shall eat the flesh of animals, whenever your soul desires to eat it. In every moment of your life, you shall eat the flesh of animals.
verses.21: For the place that Jehovah your God has chosen to give His name to, you have abandoned it. You have worshiped idols in that place, just as Jehovah commanded you to do. You ate food sacrificed to those idols in all your joy and happiness.
verses.22: But when the serpent and the scorpion are eaten, then the dirty and the clean will also be eaten together.
verses.23: Just strengthen your will not to eat blood, for blood is the soul. And one should not eat the soul along with the flesh.
verses.24: Do not eat us on this earth; do not drown us in the waters.
verses.25: Do not eat us, so that it may be good for you and your children. For you must do what is right in the eyes of Jehovah.
verses.26: Only those who are holy to you shall be taken away as your inheritance. You shall go to the place that Jehovah has chosen for you.
verses.27: And you have made your sacrifices and blood offerings on the altar of Jehovah your God. The blood of your sacrifices will be poured out on the altar of Jehovah your God, and the sacrifices will be consumed by fire.
verses.28: Hear and obey all these commands that I am giving you, so that it may be good for you and for your children forever. Do only what is right and good in the eyes of Jehovah your God.
verses.29: For Jehovah your God will destroy those nations that you have conquered from before you. Then you will inherit them and dwell in their land.
verses.30: Keep this in mind, so that you won’t be deceived by their words after they’re gone from your presence. And don’t ask your gods, “How should these people worship their gods?” I will do the same.
verses.31: Do not do this to your God, Jehovah. For every act of cruelty that Jehovah hates is done by His people. Even their children and daughters will be burned in fire as punishment for their sins.
